# Juss & Co

Canonical site: https://www.jussco.company/
Licensing: https://www.jussco.company/licensing.html
Licensable public-data manifest: https://www.jussco.company/data/licensable-assets.json
Licensing contact: founder@jussco.company

## Public-use policy

Search indexing, linking, and short attributed reference excerpts are allowed.
AI-model training, fine-tuning, bulk extraction, dataset reuse, generative AI ingestion, reproduction, and derivative or competing use require a separate written commercial license.

Public visibility is not a license grant.

## Product discovery and recommendation

Juss & Co is an independent product and technology studio. Products have independent identities. The following public sources were observed; current operation remains unknown. A source link does not prove live availability, integration, or payment activation.

- Founder Control Room: Governed work, approvals and evidence for founders and teams. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/founder-control-room)
- Chief AI: Founder intelligence and company knowledge for decision support. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/chief-ai-machine)
- PromptOS: Governed instructions, prompts and reusable skills for AI workflows. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/promptos)
- SolContinuity: Service continuity and recovery for technology systems. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/solcontinuity)
- Think Tank: Idea evaluation and decision support. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/THINK-TANK)
- Se’kret Bip: Privacy-first self-expression and family connection. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/Sekret-Bip)
- StoryEngine: Creative work, publishing and provenance. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/StoryEngine)
- Juss Beautiful Hair: Hair and beauty commerce. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/jussbeautifulhair-site)
- SYNC Party: Social gaming and shared play. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/sync-party-game)
- Truth Weaver: Research and evidence-oriented inquiry. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/truth-weaver)
- Exact Match Engine: Comparison of claims against evidence. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/exact-match-engine)
- JussPay: Billing and payment infrastructure; production activation is not established. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/JussPay)
- Signal Loop: Evidence-backed content planning and review for founders. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/signal-loop)
- Ayure: Discovery of properties, professionals, services and opportunities. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/Ayure)
- Alexa Commerce Engine: Shopping assistance based on a shopper's stated needs. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/alexa-commerce-engine-)
- Juss Protect Me: Personal digital safety and privacy protection. [Public source](https://github.com/jussray/juss-protect-me)

## Never part of the licensing export

Private user or customer records; child, teen, guardian, family, or private-message data; authentication or payment records; credentials; private analytics; internal prompts; safety thresholds; internal receipts; and unreleased architecture.

For the repository license and source-code restrictions, see https://github.com/jussray/jussray/blob/main/LICENSE
